---
title: "Listen"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

Press play and the year fills in clockwise from October. Each ring is one record, and it glows when its instrument is sounding. Hover over a ring or the score to read any day's value, and click to jump to that moment; the panel beside the rings shows every record's value on the day you're hearing. Link straight to a piece with `?piece=okanagan_wy2024`. The page also works [on its own, full screen](listen/index.html).

<iframe class="companion" id="companion" src="listen/index.html?embed" title="Water Year Rings listening companion" loading="eager"></iframe>

<script>
// listen.html?piece=okanagan_wy2024 opens that piece in the companion.
(() => { const p = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('piece');
  if (p && /^[a-z0-9_]+$/.test(p)) document.getElementById('companion').src = 'listen/index.html?embed&piece=' + p; })();
// The companion posts its content height; grow the frame to fit it.
window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
  if (e.data && typeof e.data.wyrHeight === 'number') {
    document.getElementById('companion').style.height = (e.data.wyrHeight + 8) + 'px';
  }
});
</script>
